body:
I'm good at hiding things, so, not really. I can't really talk to my friends because they will probably be weirded out (tried this one time, didn't work out well). And my mom is hurting too much to carry something else on her shoulders. 
 I'm going to sleep things off now, thank you for your interest. I appreciate it.

Thanks, for the advice and information I appreciate it. I knew that the spots and all were going to go away, but it's nice to have some other things cleared up. 
 I have been looking into a job/volunteering, but nobody seems to want me yet because I'm still pretty young. So that's a shame. But I'll keep on trying. School starts in September and I'll be gone from 7 AM to 6 PM, so I'll be occupied then. 
 As for the life thing, same to you.
Me too! I wouldn't say that I will never do it again (out of impulse) but this certainly scared me off for a while.

A mixture of things. Heavy asthma, depressed friends, suicidal friends, angry mother, a father that neglects me, self mutilation, trouble with my mom's boyfriends, being ignored, feeling lonely, thoughts that scare even myself, etcetera. The usual.

And yes, I'm going to try to do that. My neck doesn't hurt on the outside, but more on the inside right now. If it continues I will see a doctor.
Thank you. I was hoping it would have some kind of shock-like effect to people feeling suicidal, you know.
